Hello AICEP - Portugal Trade & Invest team,

We have just built a page for you on PrompTugal.news, about AICEP - Portugal Trade & Invest at Web Summit Lisbon, from public pages. Could you check it is correct?
https://promptugal.news/companies/aicep/

We would like to hear what AICEP - Portugal Trade & Invest sees in AI coming to Portugal and Europe, in 15 minutes during the summit, 9 to 12 November. Answering is optional, and two lines in writing are as welcome as a call. If you would rather talk than publish, we can just talk. Reply with a time that suits you.

Best regards,
[the sender, from the Web Summit team]
PrompTugal.news
